rootCausesOfRoleMixing: Single generic RoleDashboard.tsx component with role conditionals, hard-coded fake schedule/alerts/quick links, used by the Student page.
/api/dashboard/student, /api/dashboard/parent, /api/dashboard/faculty return hard-coded fake metrics ('3.80 / 4.0', '88%', '₹0.00') instead of computed records.
/api/dashboard generic fallback returns institution-wide metrics to ANY unhandled role.
dashboardPathForRole() returns '/dashboard' for REGISTRAR/DEAN/HOD/etc., causing a redirect-to-self loop.
Sidebar defaults every unhandled role to the FACULTY navigation.
Role dashboard pages lived OUTSIDE the (dashboard) route group, so they rendered without the shared application shell (sidebar/header/demo banner).
Client-only RoleDashboardGuard with no server-side page-level role enforcement (API routes enforce independently).
dataLeakageRisks: Generic /api/dashboard fallback exposes institution-wide user/courseOffering/notice counts to any authenticated role.
SUPER_ADMIN branch of /api/dashboard uses unscoped prisma.institution.count() (platform-wide) without tenant context.
Dashboard pages fetched role payloads client-side and rendered any field present in the response (no contract shaping at the page).
LiveScheduleWidget hard-coded a faculty name and course code visible to the student dashboard.
navigationIssues: REGISTRAR, DEAN, HOD, FINANCE_OFFICER, ACCOUNTANT, HR_ADMIN, WARDEN, LIBRARIAN, TRANSPORT_MANAGER, PLACEMENT_OFFICER, ADMISSIONS_COUNSELLOR, EXAMINATION_CONTROLLER all received the FACULTY sidebar.
Role dashboard pages rendered outside the shell, so sidebar navigation was not visible on /dashboard/*.
cacheAndPersonaSwitchingRisks: Zustand auth store persists currentSession in localStorage (campusos-auth-storage); persona switching calls setSession which replaces the session.
Dashboard fetch uses cache: 'no-store'; no React Query/SWR keys in the role dashboard path.
No dashboard-level data persisted in sessionStorage; no stale-role flash identified in the student flow.
Recommend adding userId+tenantId+activeRole to any future dashboard cache keys.
